review_notes: I read the whole file. I looked at the private helper map_mkQ_comul_comp, quotientTensorQuotient_isCoideal, the quotientTensorQuotientCoalgEquiv definition, and the later lemmas and the unique-factorization proof. The only repetition I found that I think is worth reporting is the comparison with the linear equivalence e and the comultiplication transport chain. It appears in the isCoideal proof and in the map_comp_comul field. The repeated `obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := p.mkQ_surjective x` pairs and the small `ext'; rfl` blocks are short routine steps, so I only mention them as part of this pattern. I did not look for other possible duplication with Mathlib, and I did not compile the suggested rewrite. The size of the gain is modest.

findings.problem: The same two facts are proved separately in two places. (1) The identity `e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ map p.mkQ q.mkQ = (relation sum).mkQ` is proved three times by `ext'; intro; rfl`. The copies are `he` at line 83, `he` at line 133, and the theorem `quotientTensorQuotientCoalgEquiv_comp_map_mkQ`. (2) The transport chain `map (Σ).mkQ (Σ).mkQ (comul z) = map e e (map π π (comul z)) = map e e (comul (π z))` is written out twice, with the same `map_map`, `he` and `map_mkQ_comul_comp` rewrites. The first copy is in the coideal proof at lines 107-113. The second is in the `map_comp_comul` field at lines 153-161, read in the reverse direction. Each copy has to restate the long `map … (comul …)` goal by hand with `change`. A change to the construction, for example to the choice of `e`, then has to be made in several places.
findings.proposed_change:
Before `quotientTensorQuotient_isCoideal`, add a private lemma with no coideal instance on the sum. Let `I` be the explicit sup and `e := quotientTensorQuotientEquiv p q`. The lemma has two parts:
(a) `e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ map p.mkQ q.mkQ = I.mkQ`, proved by `TensorProduct.ext'; intro x y; rfl`.
(b) `map I.mkQ I.mkQ ∘ₗ comul = map e e ∘ₗ comul ∘ₗ map p.mkQ q.mkQ`, proved by rewriting `I.mkQ` with (a), then `map_comp` and `map_mkQ_comul_comp p q`.
In the isCoideal proof, the comultiplication case becomes `rw [(LinearMap.congr_fun (b) x)]; simp [hπ x hx]`, and `he` is replaced by (a). The `CoalgEquiv` definition uses (a) for `he`, and `map_comp_comul` follows from (b) applied to `x ⊗ₜ y` after `obtain`. The later theorem `quotientTensorQuotientCoalgEquiv_comp_map_mkQ` becomes `(a)` with `Σ` unfolded.
findings.benefit: The linear comparison and the comultiplication transport are proved once, in a place where no coalgebra structure on the quotient by the sum is assumed. This keeps that invariant visible. The two main proofs shrink to their real content: the vanishing argument for the coideal, and the field verification for the equivalence. The long hand-written `change` and `calc` goals are no longer duplicated, so there is less to maintain.
